description: Python script for manipulating PDF and FDF files using pdftk, including functions to extract form field keys, fill PDF forms, and generate test PDFs.

methods.name: output_field
methods.description: Encodes a field name into a specific byte format for FDF files.

methods.name: extract_keys
methods.description: Extracts form field keys from lines of an FDF file.

methods.name: write_field
methods.description: Writes a single form field to an output stream in FDF format.

methods.name: write_fields
methods.description: Writes multiple form fields to an output stream in FDF format.

methods.name: extract_keys_from_pdf
methods.description: Uses pdftk to generate an FDF file from a PDF and extracts form field keys.

methods.name: fill_pdf
methods.description: Fills a PDF form with specified fields using pdftk.

methods.name: testfill_pdf
methods.description: Creates a test FDF with all field keys and fills a PDF form.
